releaseNotes:
🌊 120FPS Cinematic Crossfade: Ultra-fluid 3D perspective sweep with GPU blur between songs.
🎤 Musical 3-Dot Interludes: Apple Music-style instrumental countdown accurately synced to song tempo.
📱 Redesigned Popups & Scrubber: Sleek glassmorphic player menus, fluid progress bar, & spring animations.
📋 120Hz Queue Auto-Scroll: Smooth edge auto-scrolling while dragging to reorder tracks.
🛠️ Spotify Sync & Stability Fixes: Resolved Spotify sync drops, lyrics desync, and post-crossfade glitches.
